product.name: Biodock Deep AI Platform
product.description: A cloud-based AI platform for training, running, and interpreting deep learning models on biological image data without coding.

product.name: AI-Assisted Labeling Tools
product.description: Interactive tools that assist users in labeling biological images quickly using AI, including Click AI powered by SAM AI for identifying cells and structures.

product.name: Distributed Compute Execution
product.description: A distributed computing system that runs AI pipelines on large clusters to accelerate image analysis up to 3000 times faster at any scale.

product.name: Results Dashboard and Visualization Tools
product.description: A dashboard that displays analysis results with quantitative metrics, interactive object viewers, and tools for statistical comparison and data export.

product.name: Image Filesystem and Data Integration
product.description: A system to organize and connect biological image files from various cloud storage providers with seamless viewing and sharing capabilities.
